authoritative_source.title: Atomium
authoritative_source.notes: City of Brussels publishes 102 m total height, 9 spheres, 18 m sphere diameter, 20 connecting tubes, 3.30 m tube diameter and 3 supporting pillars.

official_atomium_site_source.title: Interior architecture
official_atomium_site_source.notes: Official Atomium site independently confirms 18 m stainless-steel sphere diameter.

official_heritage_source.title: Atomium — Square de l'Atomium
official_heritage_source.notes: Official heritage inventory states that the three lower spheres are supported by bipods and that the base sphere rests on a circular pavilion 26 m in diameter. It does not provide exact bipod foot coordinates, global yaw, or pavilion height, so those remain unresolved.

workspace_geometry_handoff.warning: Long-lived workspace branch is evidence-only and must never be merged wholesale. Support-foot orientation was explicitly provisional in PR #2.

remaining_major_mismatches: exact global yaw/orientation against orthophoto or survey evidence
